_help: Fallback for banks centralbank.watch does not publish probabilities for (it links out to CME FedWatch for the Fed, and omits the RBNZ). Fill hike/hold/cut as percentages plus next_meeting and src. Set "override": true to beat a scraped value. Leave a bank out entirely rather than guessing - a missing expectation is handled, an invented one is not.

USD.src: researched 2026-09-06 (re-check). 4 Sep August NFP printed +162k vs ~53k expected (strongest since March), unemployment 4.1%, AHE +3.1% y/y - a clear beat. CME FedWatch moved to ~58% hike for 16 Sep (Briefing.com 58.2%), interest-rate swaps implied 'above 60%'. Path: ~40% (21 Aug) -> ~57% post-Warsh (28 Aug) -> dipped on the 3 Sep ADP miss -> back to ~58-62% after payrolls. 10 Sep CPI is the last test before the meeting.

JPY.src: researched 2026-09-09 (re-check). centralbank.watch BoJ tool shows 63.4% hike / 36.6% hold for the 17 Sep meeting (25bp to 1.25%), ~51bp of tightening priced across the next three meetings. Reuters/Yahoo (Aug) report the BoJ 'eyeing a September hike and a faster pace of tightening'; some desks quote 80-90% but the TONA-futures-implied figure is ~63%. Scraper still misses the BoJ block, so hand-entered.

EUR.src: researched 2026-09-10. The ECB hiked 25bp on 10 Sep (deposit to 2.50%), so the scraped centralbank.watch value (89% hike) now points at a meeting that has already happened - override to the next meeting, 29 Oct. Markets price roughly 29% for a further 25bp hike on 29 Oct (cryptobriefing/Reuters), with ECB officials briefing that October is 'in play' (Bloomberg) and inflation staff-projected at 3.0% 2026. Data-dependent, no pre-commitment.

NZD.src: researched 2026-09-10 (re-check of the 3 Sep entry). centralbank.watch RBNZ tool now shows ~89% no-change for 28 Oct (0% hike / ~10% cut in the OIS-implied split). RBNZ's own OCR track still points to one more 25bp hike to 3.00% by the 9 Dec MPS, so the tightening bias is intact but October is priced as a near-certain hold - small hike tail kept for the December-live view, the tool's cut tail treated as OIS convexity rather than a real easing call.

CAD.src: researched 2026-09-10 (re-check of the 3 Sep entry). Bond-market/prediction-market pricing for 28 Oct is a heavy hold - rateprobability/Polymarket around 6-12% for a 25bp hike, majority of economists see a hold through 2026. The 2 Sep statement held at 2.25% for a 7th meeting and leaned on upside inflation risks (CPI ~3%, energy, US-Canada tariffs) but gave no signal, so a modest hike tail is kept.

_note_CAD: Rate-odds source rotated to public reporting after bankofcanadaodds.com; the TradingView scrape carries a stale 5.25% BoC rate and no real BoC block, so override stays true. If a cleaner current feed appears, prefer it.
